gradient-locked.note: MAS, 8 donor volumes, CPU backend, no alignment or upsampling, locked EEG/MRI clocks. Recorded 2026-08-25. A mean template over 8 donors ceilings at sqrt(9)=3.00; a median is less efficient by sqrt(pi/2)=1.253, predicting ~2.39. Measured 2.47, so the analytic reasoning and the implementation agree. Changing the method, donor count, backend, or the scenario requires re-recording this with EVA_UPDATE_WATERMARK=1 -- and the change should be visible in that commit.

clean-control.note: Artifact-free, average-referenced simulator output passed through an empty filter stage plus a redundant continuous common-average reference. Recorded 2026-08-25. RMS amplitude ratio was 1.0000000000 and maximum absolute error was 3.814697266e-06 microvolts. The analytic bounds in the test remain authoritative; this watermark catches drift within those bounds.

gradient-drifting.note: MAS with 8 donors, CPU backend, alignment and 10x sub-sample correction under the paper's 152 us/s clock drift. Recorded 2026-08-25. Uncorrected SNR is approximately 0.065, so the low absolute score still represents a little over twofold improvement in this deliberately difficult case.

bcg-jitter.note: Pan-Tompkins detection on the simulated ECG followed by EVA MAS with AMRI preprocessing and a 21-beat local template. Four-generator BCG, 25 ms simulated detector-marker jitter, 60 s at 250 Hz. Recorded 2026-08-25.

oddball-erp.note: Thirty-trial oddball (six targets, one omitted response), baseline-corrected and category-averaged headlessly. Error is measured at the truth topography's strongest sensor against the simulator's exact target-average peak. Recorded 2026-08-25.

recording-defects.note: The two known bad channels are the two lowest ChannelHealth scores; the planted bridge is perfectly correlated; the bad-reference contamination leaves a 30.7 uV common-mode RMS. Recorded 2026-08-25.

bcg-pcas.note: Surrogate-source separation (PCA-S) on the 32-channel bcg-labeller-train-standard case: four-generator BCG at field strength 3, dipole EEG from seven sources, 30 s at 200 Hz, no gradient. Pan-Tompkins beats from the simulated ECG, package coordinates, classic three-shell head, 29 regional sources, 2% brain regularization, iterative pattern search. Recorded 2026-08-27: SNR 0.778 to 1.344, 38 of 40 beats accepted, four artifact components retained with split-half reliabilities 0.95-1.00 (the paper reports 4-8 per subject), 88% of the variance removed. The oracle spatial-filter ceiling for this case is 321, so the anti-leakage bound is loose here by construction -- the simulated BCG is exactly low-rank, which an oracle fitted on the truth can null almost perfectly and no honest method can. It still catches the failure it exists for: a score in the hundreds would mean the clean recording had reached the correction.
